subject: Invoice 2026-07: unexpected surge and proposed partial waiver
messages:
From: Tom Greene <tgreene@allegrasys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Allegra Systems Billing <billing@allegrasys.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:23:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected high usage on invoice 2026-07

Hi Irene,

I hope you’re well. We just received invoice-2026-07 and noticed a substantial usage spike on the July bill that doesn’t match our internal telemetry. The line item shows ~1.8M tokens for a single connector, which is ~6x our expected monthly volume.

Can you help investigate? Specifically:
- Can you confirm which model + connector generated the tokens?
- Can you share the raw usage window for our account (CSV) so we can reconcile?
- If there’s an error on Redwood’s side, what’s the process/timeline for a credit or corrected invoice?

I attached the invoice PDF from our side for reference. This is urgent because our accounting team needs an adjusted invoice for Q3 close if there’s a mistake.

Thanks,
Tom Greene
Director of Platform Operations
Allegra Systems

--- Attachment: invoice-2026-07.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Tom Greene <tgreene@allegrasys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected high usage on invoice 2026-07

Tom — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice.

We’ve started an internal lookup. Preliminary read shows repeated retries from one connector around July 7th that could have caused duplicate ingest events; I’m looping in Ben from Finance to propose the remediation.

I’ve attached a short sample of the usage window (first/last 100 rows) so you can peek at the raw events while we complete the full reconciliation. Could you also confirm whether any internal batch jobs at Allegra might have re-ingested data during that timeframe?

Next steps I’ll take:
- Ben will review the ledger and propose a credit path.
- Engineering will confirm whether those tokens were charged more than once (dedup logic).
- We’ll provide a single corrected invoice/credit memo if Redwood is at fault.

Best,
Irene Choi
AM, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

--- Attachment: usage_window_2026-07.csv (CSV stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Greene <tgreene@allegrasys.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected high usage on invoice 2026-07 — proposed remediation

Hi Tom / Irene,

Thanks for raising this. Finance completed a preliminary reconciliation of the July billing for Allegra Systems. Summary:

- Root cause: connector retry loop during a July 7 migration window created duplicated request batches for your tenant. Engineering confirmed ~1.2M duplicated tokens out of the ~1.8M posted.
- Gross overage amount: $13,032.
- Goodwill / remediation proposal: Redwood will apply a courtesy credit of 35% of the overage amount (we typically reserve 100% refunds for platform faults >48hr SLA impact; in this case the duplication is localized and we’re proposing a mixed remedy to keep you operational while we harden the connector). Proposed credit: $4,561.20.

Operational details we propose:
1) Issue a credit memo (CM-ALRG-2197) for $4,561.20 to be applied against your next invoice.
2) Re-issue a corrected July invoice showing the credit as a line item so your accounting team has a PDF for Q3 close.
3) Post a journal entry in our ledger with reference ACCT-2197; the credit will reflect on your account within 5 business days of your written acceptance.

Attached is a proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx that shows the math and the proposed ledger posting. Notes on tax: Allegra is located in the US so we’re not applying VAT to the credit; if you require a tax-adjusted credit memo for an EU subsidiary please flag the region and we’ll route to Tax to produce the appropriate documentation.

If this is acceptable I’ll put the credit memo into draft and send the corrected invoice PDF for signature/record.

Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx (XLSX stub)
--- Accounting ref: ACCT-2197 | Journal ID: JRNL-76042

From: Tom Greene <tgreene@allegrasys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected high usage on invoice 2026-07 — proposed remediation

Ben / Irene — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the clear proposal.

Allegra accepts the credit memo CM-ALRG-2197 for $4,561.20 and the plan to apply it against our next invoice. Two quick asks before you finalize:
- Can you send the corrected July invoice PDF (with credit line) in a single file we can upload to our ERP?
- Please confirm the exact date the credit will post to our account so our AR team knows when to expect the ledger change.

If we can get the updated PDF and a posting date, I’ll close this loop on our side immediately.

Appreciate the collaboration — Tom
Tom Greene
Director of Platform Operations
Allegra Systems
